events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hello. My name is Theo Lindquist. Date of birth November 2nd, 1979. Could you send a refill request for my sertraline?
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, sertraline fifty milligram tablets, one tablet in the morning, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?

Your request is pending but not confirmed, so I cannot give a reference. Please contact the Cedar Clinic prescription desk on five five five, zero one four two, open weekdays from eight in the morning to six in the evening.
